architecture.method: positive features with paired BDH RoPE; no-self bidirectional associative kernel; multiplicative coactivation; shared refinements
architecture.initialization: copy removed native layer16 up/gate/down; no new zero gate

plan.training: all used language parameters and tied embedding/head; vision and skipped native blocks frozen
plan.optimizer: AdamW FP32 master betas(.9,.95), WD.01, global clip1
plan.selection: old exposed 4147 cases; primary common-update 1024 comparisons; trained-best snapshots secondary
plan.confirmation: none unless architecture exceeds native-large selection by >=0.5pp; a new audited holdback would then be required
plan.train_probe: fixed512 small-pool cases, seen in both data conditions; diagnostic only
limits: three arms, not a complete 2x2 factorial
one seed; repeated selection, not independent confirmation
retrofit of a trained decision model, not pretraining a new architecture from scratch

manifest.scope: large is sampled from full previously audited gold6 training; inherited selection exclusion of all gold2/3/6 training plus direct disjoint check; not a semantic paraphrase audit

fixed_1024_update_architecture_differenc.scope: exploratory paired interval on repeatedly exposed selection; not confirmation

fixed_1024_update_data_difference.scope: exploratory paired interval on repeatedly exposed selection; not confirmation

diagnostic_scope: descriptive exposed-selection bins; not extra confirmation tests or selection criteria

initial_training_pool_overlap.scope: membership in original gold3 decision-training file; not proof an exact row was drawn during base fitting, nor an audit of foundation pretraining

cycle_probe_scope: fixed512 exposed selection; model trained at3; diagnostic only, no reselection from this probe

timing.scope: trained models, same prepared GPU batches, alternated warm passes; excludes tokenization/loading; not a service benchmark

limits: three arms, not a complete 2x2 factorial
one seed; repeated selection, not independent confirmation
retrofit of a trained decision model, not pretraining a new architecture from scratch
native-small not trained; no architecture-data interaction estimate
different logical parameter/FLOP counts; BDH replaced eight pretrained blocks with a shared small core
same initial decision checkpoint, not equal pretraining from scratch
data intervention is source-matched nested sampling, not a guarantee that only semantic information quantity differs
